sentences.en: He lost his eyesight when he was still a child.
sentences.zh: 他还是个孩子的时候就失明了。

sentences.en: Some people say that eating carrots will improve your eyesight.
sentences.zh: 有人说吃胡萝卜能改善视力。

sentences.en: Poor eyesight has its advantages, for example - it develops imagination.
sentences.zh: 视力差也有好处，比如可以激发想象力。

senses.zh: 视觉，视力,见解，观察,眼力
